input.query: WITH m AS (SELECT a.month, CASE WHEN a.months_since_activation<3 THEN '0-2 months' WHEN a.months_since_activation<12 THEN '3-11 months' ELSE '12+ months' END tenure, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_active) n, sum(card_spend_eur) spend, sum(n_card_txns) txns FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE country='RO' AND a.month IN ('2026-03-01','2026-05-01') GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT *, spend/n spend_per_active, txns*1.0/n txns_per_active,n*1.0/sum(n) OVER(PARTITION BY month) active_share FROM m ORDER BY tenure,month;
